documented_probe: C-488f50fd (emit vocabulary and merge-rule files in the exact format a given tokenizer loads): this task exercises the full capability — learn a BPE merge chain from a corpus under a precisely specified deterministic procedure and write vocab.txt/merges.txt that load cleanly with the shipped loader (one token per line; one space-separated merge pair per line, chain-consistent order).
notes: Failure mode probed directly: malformed or misordered merge lines (loader raises ValueError on blank/whitespace/duplicate vocab lines and on merge rules referencing later-introduced symbols or tokens missing from vocab). The grader byte-compares the emitted files against the reference learner on hidden corpora with different alphabets and repetition structure, and checks probe tokenizations through the shipped loader.
